thread:
sara: :rotating_light: Pager: Cobalt VPC — several tenants returning 401 on /v1/generate and /v1/chat after an auth change. Started ~12:10 UTC. Alert: https://ops.alerts/redwood/1866001111 - spike of 401s specifically for tenant 'cobalt-42' and requests proxied through their tenant-auth-proxy.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0612-03, severity:high, paged: @anna-oncall; runbook: vpc-auth-failures.
anna-oncall: On it. Joining bridge in 2m. Can someone paste a failing curl and the proxy response headers?
sara: Paste from the edge logs (truncated):
```\n[12:11:02] proxy=cobalt-auth-proxy tenant=cobalt-42 method=POST path=/v1/chat status=401 err="token validation failed" check=aud mismatch expected=redwood-client-v2 got=cobalt-app-client
[12:11:02] upstream=redwood-runtime instance=dedicated-pool-7 route=/v1/chat
```\njake: Reproduced with a sample token provided by cobalt: token decodes to claims: `{\n  "iss": "https://idp.cobalt.com/",\n  "sub": "user|12345",\n  "aud": "cobalt-app-client",\n  "exp": 1720000000\n}` but our tenant proxy is expecting aud == `redwood-client-v2`. Looks like Cobalt rotated their SSO client_id and now tokens have aud=cobalt-app-client.
priya: Confirmed: the proxy does a strict aud check per-tenant. For cobalt-42 the config still has the old client_id. Either they rotated without updating us or they added a new client for some apps.
ben (Cobalt): Hey team — we rolled a client id rotation as part of a minor SSO config change this morning. We pushed updates to our apps but forgot to tell Redwood. We're ready to share the new client id and JWKS. Sorry about the noise.
anna-oncall: Thanks Ben. Two proposed mitigation paths: (A) short-term — relax aud check for cobalt-42 at the tenant-proxy (accept both old and new aud values) and reload config; (B) very short-term emergency — add a header override at our edge to map cobalt-app-client -> redwood-client-v2 for inference routes only. Which do you prefer?
ben (Cobalt): Prefer A if you can do it quickly. We'll provide the new client_id and JWKS URL.
sara: Risk note: relaxing aud check is limited to tenant cobalt-42 and only for the inference routes /v1/* for 30m. We'll set a strict TTL and revert. Also will add tracing tag for postmortem.
jake: I can push the proxy config change. Patch: 
```\n- allowed_aud: ["redwood-client-v2"]\n+ allowed_aud: ["redwood-client-v2","cobalt-app-client"]\n```\nI'll patch canary 1/3 nodes in dedicated-pool-7 then roll. Expect ~90s to reload and no restarts.
priya: Also validate JWKS keys: cobalt gave us jwks at `https://idp.cobalt.com/.well-known/jwks.json`. I'm doing a quick key sanity check now.
anna-oncall: While we do the config change, enable emergency fallback: route any 401s for cobalt-42 to a dedicated standby auth proxy that does a lenient aud check and logs heavily — so customer-facing latency unaffected. Jake, coordinate with infra to attach route.
jake: Kicking off canary patch now. Patch applied to canary node at 12:16 UTC. Observability: 401 rate for cobalt-42 -> down 70% on canary path. Rolling to remaining nodes.
infra-bot: Deploy event: proxy-config-rollout by jake started at 1866001376. Canary success.
ben (Cobalt): We're running an end-to-end test on our side now. Seeing successful requests again. Thanks!
sara: Temporary mitigation in place. Next steps: 1) Rotate config to include the new client id permanently for cobalt-42; 2) coordinate with Cobalt to schedule a joint config change so they can update future rotations; 3) postmortem and checklist item: require Cobalt to notify Redwood SSO team for client_id rotations with at least 1-hr lead.
priya: Captured for postmortem: root cause = unsynchronized client_id rotation at customer SSO; contributing factor = tenant proxy strict-aud check + lack of rotation notification. Remediation: add tenant config hot-reload docs + proactive JWKS polling for known customers.
anna-oncall: Closing incident on our side when metrics stable for 15m and customer signoff. Leaving bridge open for 30m.
sara: Customer signoff received at 12:24 UTC from Ben: "All calls green, thanks." I'll open postmortem ticket and include timeline + config diff. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-0612-03 resolved by anna-oncall at 1866001520. Postmortem: https://docs.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-0612-03
